title: What information did filling remove?
hook: Four training rows; preserve the difference between absent and observed.

objective: Compute the missing data signal construction and explain its countercase and stated boundary.

claims.text:
Target / packet: `ai-missing-data-signal` · `C1`. Prerequisites: `ai:data-leakage`.

Nearest / distinct payoff: `data-leakage` → `duplicates-in-the-test` (existing registered artifact; evidence applicability pending). Unlike leakage, this keeps observation-time evidence valid but distinguishes missingness information from imputed numeric values.

Primary finite model: Four x values[5,null,5,null], y=[0,1,0,1]. Mean imputation makes all x=5, majority tie rule0 gets2/4; indicator missing→1 gets4/4.

Countercase and boundary: Change y to[0,0,1,1]: indicator gets2/4, showing no guaranteed benefit. Fit means using training values only; missingness can shift at deployment.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict whether imputed values alone separate labels; recall what changes if missingness-label relation disappears.

Required evidence: Show observed, missing, filled and indicator fields on four rows. No causal assertion that missingness produces the outcome.
